name: frontend-devkit
description: A domain-neutral core for software work in any repository - feature lifecycle, bug fixing in any layer, review, commit and MR text - plus a frontend plugin for Vue, Nuxt, React and Next.js. Every project fact is read from the files a repository already maintains; no component carries a fact about an individual repository.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Domain-neutral, for any repository: a feature lifecycle with automatic review, bug investigation and fixing in any layer, branch syncing, commit/MR authoring and repo preparation. Install in every repository.

plugins.name: frontend
plugins.description: Frontend engineering and review knowledge for Vue 3, Nuxt, React SPAs and Next.js: one router skill selects a framework's rules per workspace from its package.json and loads only that set. Version-gated. Contains no repo-specific facts. Depends on no other plugin.
